name: Ferrite
description: Ferrite is self-hosted DNS that blocks ads and trackers — and routes chosen domains or devices through a tunnel. A Pi-hole-style sinkhole in one Rust binary that goes further: selective routing through built-in userspace WireGuard (no root, no TUN), SOCKS5/Tor, or a DPI-evasion path; encrypted upstream resolvers (DoH/DoT/DoQ) with DNSSEC forwarding; per-device query history keyed by MAC; live query log and a web/API management surface with hot-reload.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Stores Ferrite config, SQLite database, blocklist cache, snapshots, and web assets.

ports.name: DNS TCP
ports.description: DNS TCP listener for name resolution.

ports.name: DNS UDP
ports.description: DNS UDP listener for name resolution.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Ferrite API and web UI. Also intercepts HTTP for routed domains (demultiplexed by Host header).

ports.name: HTTPS Routing
ports.description: HTTPS (SNI) intercept for the selective-routing/tunnels feature. Only bound while routing is enabled. Must stay 443:443 for routing to work; leave unmapped if tunnels are not used.

variables.name: Server Release Version
variables.description: Use latest to install the newest Ferrite release on container start. Set a fixed version, for example 0.1.1, to disable automatic server release updates on restart.

variables.name: Web Release Version
variables.description: Optional web UI release version. Leave blank to follow Server Release Version; set a fixed version to pin the web UI separately.

variables.name: Panel IP
variables.description: Optional LAN IP for the built-in fe.te A record. In bridge networking set this to the Unraid host IP, for example 192.168.1.5. Leave blank to auto-detect.

variables.name: Panel Domain
variables.description: Optional override for the built-in panel shortcut domain. Leave blank for the default fe.te.

variables.name: Panel URL
variables.description: Optional startup-log URL for the panel shortcut. If Web UI is mapped to a non-80 host port, set this to http://fe.te:port.

variables.name: GitHub Release Token
variables.description: Optional GitHub token used when the container downloads server and web releases on start. Leave blank for public releases. Set a token only if you hit GitHub API rate limits (anonymous requests are capped at 60/hour per IP) or pull from a private mirror.
